descriptions.text: Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness. The wearer of this cloak gains +4 to Constitution and becomes resistant to poison and ice-based attacks. In addition, the cloak adds Anti-Piercing resistance to all worn armor. It also makes you look like a dollar store Batman. Warning: if a Nightgaunt spies you wearing this, they probably won't be too happy with you.

recap.text: Carl opens his first boxes in front of Mordecai: bronze, silver, and a goblin box whose pass brands itself onto his forearm. The Gold Apparel Box gives him the Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness, a black, leathery, hooded dollar store Batman of a cloak that adds four to Constitution. When five level-two rats bite him, one inflicts Poison, but the cloak cancels it after a second.

A red-furred lemur in a painted human skull mask sits on a second-storey window ledge, little legs dangling, and shows on the minimap only after it throws a knife straight at Carl's head. The knife flies low, hits his chest and bounces off his jacket, because the cloak's anti-piercing benefit holds. Four more lemurs appear in the window.

Carl holds his breath as a wheel spins to pick the opponents for the next level, and one of its four choices is the Nightgaunt Precipice. Donut hopes for the foxes, but Carl hopes for anything except the Nightgaunts, because his cloak's description warned that they would be enraged by the sight of it, and he does not want to give it up. The wheel clicks three times and stops on the second choice.

A Nightgaunt, peaceful and vegetarian, catches sight of Carl's cloak by a dilapidated farmhouse and turns aggravated. The demon never plays a card; it glares at the cloak and screeches until a giant cat picks it up in his jaws and shakes it to death. The System awards the LBC achievement for taunting an opponent with a garment, since the cloak is made from the flesh of one of its friends, and a Gold Talk of the Town Box.

beats.headline: Two boxes glowing gold
beats.text: Carl's first boxes open one after another, with Mordecai watching: bronze, silver, a goblin box whose pass brands itself onto his forearm. Then it is time for the good stuff, two bigger boxes glowing with a golden light. The Gold Apparel Box holds two items, the Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness and the Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling. Beside Carl, Mordecai gasps the moment they appear. Carl hopes that is a good thing.
beats.gist: Carl opens a Gold Apparel Box holding the Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness and a Trollskin shirt; Mordecai gasps.

beats.headline: A dollar store Batman
beats.text: The black, leathery, hooded cloak weighs almost nothing. It appears to be made from the wing of some demon creature, the skin stretched between rows of long, body-length fingerbones, and when Carl puts the hood up it has pointed ear things on either side. Four to Constitution, resistance to poison and ice, anti-piercing for all his worn armour, and the look of a dollar store Batman, with a warning about Nightgaunts. Extremely valuable, says Mordecai. But the shirt is better. Much better.
beats.gist: Carl wears a black leathery hooded cloak that gives four Constitution, poison and ice resistance, and anti-piercing armour.

beats.headline: Poison for a second
beats.text: A group of five level-two rats beset Carl, screeching and hissing, each about half the size of Donut and huge for rats. They bite and scratch, and one inflicts a Poison debuff that lasts only a second before the cloak cancels it out. He defeats them by punting them against the wall one by one, and they explode like water balloons, with twice as much blood as they should have.
beats.gist: Carl punts five level-two rats against the wall one by one, and they burst like water balloons.

beats.headline: A knife off the chest
beats.text: A red-furred lemur wearing a black and red painted human skull as a mask sits on the ledge of a second-storey window, little legs dangling, and only appears on the minimap once it has thrown its knife straight at Carl's head. Luckily the knife flies low, hits him in the chest and bounces off his jacket, thanks to the cloak's anti-piercing benefit. Four more lemurs appear in the window.
beats.gist: A lemur's knife hits Carl in the chest and bounces off his jacket, thanks to the cloak.

beats.headline: Anything but the Nightgaunts
beats.text: A wheel spins to choose the opponents of the next level, and one of its four choices is the Nightgaunt Precipice. Donut hopes for the foxes. Carl holds his breath and hopes for anything but the Nightgaunt choice: his cloak's description specifically warned that Nightgaunts would be enraged by the sight of it, and he doesn't want to have to get rid of it. Click, click, click. The wheel stops on the second choice.
beats.gist: Carl hopes the wheel avoids the Nightgaunts, enraged by his cloak; it stops on the second choice.

beats.headline: A Nightgaunt sees the cloak
beats.text: Combat starts by a dilapidated farmhouse, and a warning with it: Carl's equipped cloak has aggravated the Nightgaunt. The System explains that a Nightgaunt is a real creature, semi-intelligent, peaceful, vegetarian and nocturnal, which the game uses as a demon because, well, look at them. Mordecai had warned Carl the cloak would aggravate this kind of mob, but Carl had not realized how passionately. The demon never plays a single card. It glares at the cloak and screeches one last time, until a giant cat picks it up in his jaws and shakes it to death.
beats.gist: Carl's cloak enrages a Nightgaunt, which glares and screeches until a giant cat shakes it dead.

beats.headline: A garment taunt
beats.text: Among the achievements is LBC. Every girl needs the perfect little black dress, practically weaponised when worn properly, and Carl did the same thing with a cloak: he taunted an opponent with a garment, in this case a Nightgaunt, because he is wearing a cloak made out of the flesh of one of its friends. The reward is a Gold Talk of the Town Box. Carl remembers how insane the cloak drove the creature. That time it was a good thing: it kept the monster from using its deck.
beats.gist: Carl taunts a Nightgaunt with a cloak made of its friend's flesh, earning the LBC achievement.
